title: Voice studio
summary: Is VoiceStudio here: the app, the runtime its own shell staged, the speech service on its port, and why this console bridges to it instead of embedding it.

surfaces.usb: DEGRADED(promotion pending - authored and certified on PC first, then carried to the stick per-file and hash-verified, where the stick runs its own suite)
surfaces.web: N/A(by steward decision 2026-09-26: a browser tab has no local VoiceStudio install to bridge to, so a card there could only offer a button that cannot work)

notes: Read-out (family 'info'), the voice card beside the picture engine and the song studio: what this machine can actually SAY with. Every fact is asked of its OWNER - voice_harness for the install, the runtime the vendor's shell staged, the service on its port and the licence boundary - and none of it is re-derived here, so this card cannot drift out of step with the harness that speaks. WHAT IT WILL NOT DO: it never claims the service is up because a process exists (the harness probes /api/health, the route the vendor's own shell polls), it never calls 'not installed yet' or 'still installing' a fault - both are true states on a fresh machine and are reported as states with the reason - and it never writes into the VoiceStudio install or runtime, which are the operator's application. A check that could not run is a named gap in missing[] and drags the card off green. It owns no state, writes nothing and gates nothing: its own test scans this source for write calls.
